title: harvest
tagline: Auto-compounds Morpho vault rewards for all depositors. Every depositor is a verified unique human.
description:
There is $42.7M sitting in DeFi on World Chain right now. Users deposit into Morpho vaults, earn yield, and then... nothing happens. Rewards pile up unclaimed in Merkl. Nobody auto-compounds. And here's the thing — there is no Beefy on World Chain. No Yearn. No yield aggregator of any kind. DeFiLlama confirms it: zero.

Today, if a thousand Morpho users want to claim their rewards, that's a thousand separate transactions — a thousand people doing the same thing individually.

World Chain has 25 million verified humans. None of them are getting compounded yield.
how_its_made:
Harvest was built to solve the "idle yield" problem on World Chain. While Morpho vaults are gaining TVL, rewards often sit unclaimed due to the friction of manual compounding. We bridged this gap by combining battle-tested DeFi infrastructure with cutting-edge AI agency and identity verification.

The Tech Stack & Architecture:

Smart Contracts: We forked and adapted Beefy Finance’s (MIT) VaultV7 and Strategy contracts. We integrated Permit2 for seamless, one-click deposits and built a custom adapter for Morpho Blue and Merkl on World Chain.

Identity Layer: We implemented a World ID deposit gate. By leveraging MiniKit 2.0, we ensure only Orb-verified humans can access the vault, making it the first Sybil-proof yield aggregator.

Agent Automation: The "Harvesting" logic is powered by CDP AgentKit. Instead of a traditional bot, an autonomous agent monitors APYs and Merkl rewards. It executes the harvest() function, swaps rewards via Uniswap V3, and redeposits—socializing gas costs across all users.

Frontend: A Next.js 15 World Mini App featuring a high-speed "Retro-Terminal" UI (built with Tailwind CSS) that reflects the transparency of the underlying code.
